description: Read up to 10 URLs in ONE paid call. Returns per-URL ok/status/title/text/quality plus ok_count and failed_count; one bad URL never fails the whole batch. Built for monitors, research loops and bulk extraction. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: POST https://api.firstmention.uk/s/webread/batch
name: webread__batch
